evidence.detail: Added description field to new archetype form — only the description half of the issue was fixed
Add Archetype form has Parent, Name, Description but NO rule (include/exclude cards) fields
add_rule(archetype_id) and update_cards_raw(rule_id, include, exclude) already exist and are used in edit_rules flow
post_archetypes() calls archs.add(..., description) but never calls rs.add_rule() afterwards

triage.fix_sketch: 1) In editarchetypes.mustache's 'Add Archetype' section, add optional include/exclude textarea inputs (same fields as in editrules.mustache). 2) In admin.py post_archetypes(), after archs.add() succeeds, if include/exclude fields are non-empty, call rs.add_rule(archetype_id) then rs.update_cards_raw(rule_id, include, exclude). Touch: decksite/templates/editarchetypes.mustache and decksite/controllers/admin.py.
triage.notes: Description half was fixed in 83da00c7; rule half remains. Pattern for rule creation already exists in the edit_rules handler — straightforward to duplicate in the new-archetype flow.
